annotations.title: Generate a changelog and release notes from git commit messages

description: Turn git commit messages (one per line, e.g. git log --oneline, or a JSON array of messages / GitHub commit objects) into a Keep a Changelog section, GitHub release notes (breaking changes first, contributors, compare link), the semver bump and next version from the previous one, and a launch post that fits X. Reads Conventional Commits, gitmoji and plain subjects; docs, tests, CI, dependency bumps and merges are counted, not listed. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. PAID: $0.020 per call in USDC on Base via x402 over MCP, or from prepaid credits if this server is configured with an Authorization: Bearer tkc_... header (see payment_options).

commits.description: Commit messages, one per line (URL-encoded; indented lines and "BREAKING CHANGE:" footers attach to the commit above; an optional leading short SHA is kept), or a JSON array of strings or commit objects ({sha, message} or GitHub's {sha, commit: {message}, author: {login}})

date.description: Release date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC, when there is a version)

name.description: Product name for the launch post (default: the repo name), max 60 characters

previous.description: Previous released version, e.g. v1.4.2: gives the suggested next version and the compare link

repo.description: GitHub owner/name (or URL) to link #refs, commits and the compare view

version.description: Version of this release, e.g. 1.5.0 (default: the suggested next version when previous is given, else "Unreleased")

name: generate_changelog_from_commits
title: Generate a changelog and release notes from git commit messages ($0.020)
